story.titleZh: 加斯利谴责因科拉平托事件遭受的"令人不安"辱骂
story.summaryZh: 皮埃尔·加斯利公开谴责他与家人（包括女友）在社交媒体上收到的"令人不安"的辱骂和威胁，此事与他在西班牙大奖赛阻挡队友科拉平托有关。
story.originalTitle: Gasly hits out at 'disturbing' abuse over Colapinto incident
story.summaryEn: Pierre Gasly has publicly condemned "disturbing" abuse and threats he and his family members, including his girlfriend, received on social media following the incident in which he held up his Alpine team-mate Franco Colapinto at the Spanish Grand Prix.
detailZh: 在西班牙大奖赛中阻挡阿尔派车队F1队友弗兰科·科拉平托之后，皮埃尔·加斯利抨击了他及其家人（包括女友）在社交媒体上遭受的“令人不安”的辱骂和威胁。
事情源于马德里赛道比赛尾声的一圈，当时加斯利在进圈过程中挡住了科拉平托——后者正准备以第七名完赛，但身后有迈凯伦车手奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里紧追——导致其减速后才进站。虽然这没有让科拉平托损失位置，但确实让他被压到被皮亚斯特里追近，并导致他多次通过无线电抱怨。
最终获得第12名的加斯利以及他身边的人随后在多个社交媒体平台上遭到攻击，他将这些攻击描述为不合适的。
“就我个人而言，我觉得这对我们的运动来说有点令人不安，”当The 比赛问及他如何应对社交媒体上的反击时，加斯利说道。
"我是顶级运动员，所以我知道自己会暴露在公众视野中，一直都是这样，但这些威胁和攻击的程度，我觉得完全不可接受，尤其是当波及到家人、[我的]女朋友等等时。我认为不应该出现这种情况。
"过去并不是这样的，作为一项运动，我们只是需要想办法让它变得更健康一些，因为你会暴露在外，你知道自己会遭到攻击。
"你可以被人喜欢，也可以被人讨厌，这完全没问题，但有些界限是不应该跨越的，仅仅因为你躲在屏幕和键盘后面，而这些界限被跨越的次数太多了。"
Colapinto 表示他了解这些辱骂行为，并支持 Gasly 关于必须制止这种情况发生的立场。
"我想他收到了很多人的信息," 科拉平托说。"我没有看到,因为我不怎么上社交媒体,但收到那些东西从来都不好受,尤其是当这种事发生在我所效力的车队身上时。"
"我们是队友,我们相处得非常好。我们都在为同一个结果而努力,有同样的目标和方向——那就是让阿尔派变得更好。我们始终作为一个团队在工作,看到这种情况并不好受。"
"所以,希望他们能停止这种行为。其他车手也遭遇过同样的事——去年角田裕毅也经历过,当时情况也挺糟糕的,我谈论过这件事。"
"关于干事们,Zandvoort之后我也去见了他们。在他们对我做出处罚后,我也收到了一些辱骂。在F1中,车迷的这种行为很常见,如今在任何体育项目中都是如此,这已经很普遍了。"
“很遗憾，这种情况本不应该如此常见。可以肯定的是，我们应该更加注意从每个人键盘上敲出来的那些东西、那些话。”
“作为一个团队，支持我们的方式就是推动团队向前，并一起保持坚强。”
“希望这种事不要再持续发生了。但在这项运动中，车迷的问题确实很棘手。不仅仅是我的车迷。我有一些非常狂热的车迷。他们希望我表现出色。希望他们能享受我取得的好成绩。”
科拉平托还回应了一种说法，即由于超车难度大，他和加斯利在马德里之间最终发生的事情并不是什么大问题，他指出了当时皮亚斯特里对他构成的威胁。
"嗯，我差点被 Oscar 追上！只差了0.2秒，" Colapinto 说。
"我们在车队里进行了沟通，大家一起处理好了这件事。和 Pierre、Flavio [Briatore]、Steve [Nielsen]，车队里的每个人都非常努力地去弄清楚发生了什么，以及下次如何改进。
"我想我对结果很满意。最重要的是从可以改进的地方吸取教训。下次不要再发生同样的事情——然后我们继续前进。"
这一情况源于比赛早期的虚拟安全车（VSC），这让使用中性胎起步的 Colapinto 得以进站，而 Gasly 则继续留在场上使用硬胎。
尽管加斯利在比赛后段通过无线电愤怒地抱怨了这一策略，但从结果来看这一策略是合理的，因为它让加斯利有机会在虚拟安全车、安全车或红旗出现的情况下以最高第六名完赛，而且他从来没有机会进站后还能保持积分区位置。
科拉平托在第二段比赛中被加布里埃尔·博托莱托挡住了相当长一段时间，但当这位奥迪车手在第47圈进站后，他被放了出去。随后他开始迅速逼近加斯利，皮亚斯特里也在追赶他。到第55圈开始时，他已经落后加斯利1.5秒。
当加斯利被告知将在该圈结束时进站时，车队提醒他“注意身后的弗兰科”，但从未指示他让对方超车，也没有告诉他身后对他的队友构成任何威胁。
不过，他同时也向车队表达了自己的不满，在关于科拉平托的消息发出后不久，他就说“我不想和你说话，无线电结束”。
尽管由于在马德里赛道赛道超车困难，Colapinto从未发起进攻，但他在进站圈被Gasly阻挡，使得Piastri得以将本圈开始时2.3秒的差距缩小到仅剩十分之二秒。这位迈凯伦车手从未真正接近完成超越，但Colapinto对被队友阻挡感到愤怒是情有可原的。
Gasly证实，赛后车队内部就此事的经过进行了交谈，不过两位车手都没有透露任何关于处理结果的细节。
"我们显然和车队讨论过了，"当被问及车队内部的后续影响时，Gasly说道。"当时并没有要求真正进行位置交换，但这一切都已经和车队讨论过了，一切都已澄清。"
detailEn: Pierre Gasly has hit out at "disturbing" social media abuse and threats received by him and his family members, including his girlfriend, after holding up Alpine Formula 1 team-mate Franco Colapinto in the Spanish Grand Prix.

This arose from a lap late in the Madring race when he held up Colapinto, who was on his way to finishing seventh but being chased by McLaren's Oscar Piastri, on an in-lap before pitting. Although this didn't cost Colapinto a position, it did lead to him being backed up into Piastri and caused him to complain multiple times over the radio.
Gasly, who finished 12th, and those around him were then subject to attacks on a variety of social media platforms that he has described as inappropriate.
"Personally, I find it a little bit disturbing for our sport," said Gasly when asked by The Race about how he dealt with the social media backlash.

"I'm a top athlete, so I know I'm exposed, it's always been the case, but the extent of the threats, attacks, I find completely inappropriate, especially when it reaches out to family members, [my] girlfriend etc. I don't think that should be the case.
"Things were not that way in the past and as a sport we just need to find a way to make it a healthier place because you're exposed, you know you are going to be attacked.

"You can be liked, disliked, it's completely fine, but there is a certain line that should not be crossed just because you're behind a screen and a keyboard, and these lines are crossed too many times."
Colapinto said he's aware of the abuse and backed Gasly's position about the need to stop it happening.

"I think he got a lot of people messaging him," said Colapinto. "I haven't seen it because I'm not on social media a lot, but it's never nice to get it, even more when it's happening to the team that I'm racing in.

"We are team-mates and we get on very well together. We are playing and focusing on the same result, and [have] the same goal and the same target - that is to make Alpine better. We are always working as a team and it's not nice to see it.
"So, hopefully, they can stop it. The same happened to other drivers - Yuki [Tsunoda] last year, it was quite bad as well at one point, I talked about it.

"The stewards, after Zandvoort, I went to see them as well. They had some abuse after the penalty they gave me. It happens a lot with fans in Formula 1, in any sport nowadays, it's something very common.
"Unfortunately, that shouldn't be common. Definitely, we should be taking more care about the things, the words that come out of the keyboards of everyone.
"The way to support us as a team is to push the team forward and stay strong together.

"Hopefully, it doesn't keep happening. But it's something tricky with fans in the sport. It's not just my fans. I've got some very passionate ones. They want me to do well. Hopefully, they can enjoy the good results I'm having."

Colapinto also responded to a suggestion that ultimately what happened between him and Gasly in Madrid wasn't a big deal because of the difficulty of overtaking by pointing out the threat he was under from Piastri.
"Well, I almost got overtaken by Oscar! It was two tenths behind," said Colapinto.

"We spoke in the team and we managed it together. With Pierre, with Flavio [Briatore], Steve [Nielsen], everyone in the team did a very good job in understanding what happened and how to improve it for the next time.
"I'm happy with it, I think. The most important part is to learn from the things that we can improve. The next time, not have the same thing happening - and we move forward."
The situation arose because of the early-race VSC, which had allowed Colapinto, who started on mediums, to pit while Gasly was left out on hards.

Although Gasly complained angrily about this over the radio late in the race, the strategy was justified given it gave Gasly the opportunity to finish as high as sixth in the case of a VSC or safety car, or a red flag, and he never had an opportunity to make a pitstop and emerge from the pits still in the points.

Colapinto spent a substantial period in his second stint stuck behind Gabriel Bortoleto, but had been released when the Audi driver pitted on lap 47. He then began to close on Gasly rapidly, with Piastri chasing him. By the start of lap 55, he was 1.5s behind Gasly.

When Gasly was told he would pit at the end of that lap, he was warned to "watch for Franco behind", but he was never given an instruction to let him past or told that there was any threat to his team-mate behind.
However, he was also expressing his frustration at the team, saying "I don't want to talk to you, radio over" just after the message about Colapinto.

Although Colapinto never launched an attack given the difficulty of overtaking at the Madring, being held up by Gasly's in-lap allowed Piastri to close a gap of 2.3s at the start of the lap to as little as two tenths. The McLaren driver never got close to making a pass, but Colapinto was justifiably angry at being held up by his team-mate.
Gasly confirmed that there were conversations about how this had played out after the race, although neither driver offered any detail about the outcome.

"We obviously discussed it with the team," said Gasly when asked about the fallout inside the team. "There wasn't a call for an actual swap, but it's all been discussed with the team, and it's all clear."
keyPointsZh: 事发于比赛末段，加斯利在进圈时挡住了正前往第七名完赛、身后被迈凯伦车手奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里追赶的科拉平托
此事虽未让科拉平托损失位置，但导致他被皮亚斯特里追近，并多次通过无线电抱怨
加斯利最终以第12名完赛，他表示这些社交媒体攻击并不恰当
keyPointsEn: The incident happened late in the race at Madring when Gasly held up Colapinto on an in-lap before pitting; Colapinto was on his way to finishing seventh while being chased by McLaren's Oscar Piastri
Although it did not cost Colapinto a position, he was backed up into Piastri and complained multiple times over the radio
Gasly finished 12th and described the attacks on various social media platforms as inappropriate

relatedItems.titleZh: 博塔斯解释巴库站大幅落后佩雷兹的原因
relatedItems.summaryZh: 博塔斯透露，在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上他平均每圈比凯迪拉克队友佩雷兹慢超过1.7秒，是2026赛季迄今正赛中最大的队内差距，他对此表示在直道和弯角都无法跟上节奏。
relatedItems.originalTitle: The slowest race of F1 2026 explained
relatedItems.summaryEn: Valtteri Bottas has revealed why he was on average more than 1.7 seconds per lap slower than his Cadillac team-mate Sergio Perez at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, the largest race-day intra-team deficit of the 2026 season so far.
detailZh: 瓦尔特里·博塔斯透露了上一站巴库比赛中，他相比凯迪拉克F1队友塞尔吉奥·佩雷兹速度严重不足的一些原因。
在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上，博塔斯平均每圈比佩雷兹慢超过1.7秒之多，这是2026赛季迄今正赛中最大的队内差距。甚至他的最快单圈也比佩雷兹慢1.489秒。
博塔斯在最后一圈撞上护墙，因为他在驶过1号弯逃生通道后，赛车的能量输出模式“有点混乱”，而由于多跑了距离，他在进入15号弯左弯时后刹车失效，车头撞上了护墙。
但更令人担忧的是此前惊人的速度差距，在博塔斯撞车之前，佩雷兹几乎已经套了他一圈。
“我理解从外面看起来情况很糟糕，坐在车里感觉也很糟糕，”博塔斯周四在马来西亚说。
“当时根本没办法跟上大部队。我在比赛中尝试了所有办法，也得到了很多关于我在哪里损失时间的反馈。很大一部分是在直道上，但也有相当大的一部分是在整圈的弯道中损失掉的。
“所以我一直在坚持推进直到最后，这也是为什么我在最后一圈进一号弯时锁死了轮胎。
“不过是的，关键问题是在练习中我们就已经看到我的速度不够。我无法像佩雷兹那样以同样的速度过弯，所以我们在排位赛前做了很多改动，包括一些减震器和底板，结果感觉确实好多了。
“但在正赛中，行驶品质又明显衰减了很多……我们这次改动了很多东西，所以我觉得问题在于减震器随温度衰减，还有底板……我们在某些地方仍然缺少一些压力测量点，所以对于气动部件，我还拿不到过去习惯获得的完整信息。
“通过数据你马上就能看出性能是提升还是下降，但现在底板有一些区域我们完全看不见。不过就我个人的感觉而言，更多问题出在行驶品质上——再加上动力转向整个周末都在不断衰减。所以我在整场比赛中真的很难去感受赛车。
“这些因素叠加在一起。而且动力单元的差距可能比我们预想的要大，至少从数据上看是这样。
“理论上我们有一个数字，但那是新引擎对全新引擎，也就是新规格对旧规格的对比。所以，我想就是这些因素叠加的结果。我当时确实相当慢。”
动力单元方面的差异指的是佩雷兹在巴库已经用上了升级版 ADUO 2 法拉利引擎，而博塔斯还没有。
此前这被描述为“细微差别”，但正如博塔斯所说，这次升级的效果可能比最初想象的更大。
博塔斯表示，他的 ADUO 2 引擎能否及时送到、让他能在雪邦赛道使用，可能性是“五五开”；如果赶不上，他就得等到下周的新加坡大奖赛。
他的队友佩雷兹本周末不会使用这套引擎，而是换用自己引擎池中的另一套动力单元，以便把升级版留到更能发挥作用的比赛周末再使用。
佩雷斯解释说：“我们做出了一个我们认为胜算最大的决定。”
“这就是为什么我们会在这里承受一些损失。但我们希望这会有所回报。”
“我们对这个周末并不太乐观。所以我们决定把它省下来。”
正如佩雷斯所暗示的，凯迪拉克的车手们已经为艰难的周末做好了准备，因为雪邦赛道带来了两个凯迪拉克尤其难以应对的挑战：轮胎过热和高速弯角。
正如佩雷兹所解释的，凯迪拉克目前“赛车的下压力严重不足，而且阻力很大”。
“在巴库，我基本上整场比赛都保持在超车模式上，所以才能跟住其他车手，”佩雷兹说。
“但当我超过他们之后，我就只能像个乘客一样，因为我没有直道速度。所以我们有两大问题：下压力不足和很大的阻力。”
“但我们一直都知道，第一年会很艰难。”
detailEn: Valtteri Bottas has revealed some of the reasons behind his woeful lack of pace compared to Cadillac Formula 1 team-mate Sergio Perez last time out in Baku.

Bottas was on average over a whopping 1.7 seconds slower than Perez per lap at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, the largest race day intra-team deficit of 2026 so far. Even his single fastest lap was 1.489s slower than Perez.

Bottas ended up in the wall on the final lap as his car’s deployment pattern “got a bit confused” because he went down the Turn 1 escape road, then because of the extra distance travelled his rear brakes didn’t work going into the Turn 15 left-hander, where he nosed into the barriers.
But what was more worrying was the alarming lack of pace before then, with Perez close to lapping Bottas before the latter's crash.
“I understand it looked pretty bad from the outside and felt pretty bad in the car as well,” Bottas said on Thursday in Malaysia.

“There was just no way to keep up with the pack. I tried everything during the race, and got lots of feedback on where I am losing the time. A lot of it was on the straights, but also a big chunk was just all around the lap in the corners.
“That's why I just kept pushing until the end and that's why I had to lock up on the last lap into Turn 1.

“But yeah, the main thing was we saw already in practice that I was lacking pace. I couldn't carry the same speed through the corners as Checo, so we changed a lot for the qualifying, including some dampers and the floor, and it actually felt a lot better.

“But then the ride again during the race degraded quite a lot... Again, we've changed a lot of things, so I think it's something to do with dampers degging with heat, the floor... We are still lacking a bit of pressure tappings here and there, so we still don't have the full information on aero parts that I'm used to from the past.

“You can immediately see if you're down or up, but now there are some bits of the floor where we are blind. But for me, feeling-wise, it was more the ride - that, in combination with the power steering that was degging throughout the weekend. So I was really then also struggling to feel the car throughout the race.
“So those things combined. And then the [power unit] difference was probably bigger than we thought, at least from the data.
“We've got a number in theory, but that's new engine versus new one, of the new and old spec. So yeah, I think those combined. I was pretty slow.”
The power unit difference is in reference to Perez having the upgraded ADUO 2 Ferrari engine in Baku while Bottas doesn’t yet have it.
This was previously described as a “small difference”, but as Bottas says the upgrade may be more powerful than first thought.
Bottas says it’s “50/50” if his ADUO 2 engine arrives in time for him to run it at Sepang; if not, he’ll have to wait until next week in Singapore.
Team-mate Perez won’t be running it this weekend, swapping to a different power unit in his pool in order to save it for a weekend when it will be more beneficial.
“We took a decision where we feel we got the best shot at it,” Perez explained.
“That's why we're taking a bit of a hit here. But we hope that it will pay us back.
“We are not too optimistic about this weekend. So we decided to save it.”
As Perez alluded, the Cadillac drivers are braced for a difficult weekend because Sepang poses two challenges the Cadillac struggles with in particular: tyre overheating and high-speed corners.
As Perez explains, the Cadillac has “a massive lack of load in the car and a lot of drag” right now.
“In Baku, I basically stayed on the overtake mode for the entire race and therefore I was able to stay with the others,” Perez said.
“But when I overtook them, I was just a passenger because I had no straightline speed. So we have two big issues: load and a lot of drag.
“But we always knew this first year was going to be tricky.”
keyPointsZh: 博塔斯的最快单圈也比佩雷兹慢1.489秒
他因驶入1号弯逃生通道导致能量输出模式混乱，15号弯后刹车失灵撞上护墙
佩雷兹在博塔斯撞车前几乎已经套圈
keyPointsEn: Bottas's fastest single lap was still 1.489s slower than Perez's
His car's deployment pattern got confused after he took the Turn 1 escape road, leaving his rear brakes without effect at Turn 15 where he nosed into the barriers
Perez was close to lapping Bottas before the Finn's crash on the final lap

relatedItems.titleZh: 奥孔与哈斯关系破裂的多重原因
relatedItems.summaryZh: 埃斯特班·奥孔离开哈斯车队时再度提及“超出自己控制的因素”，暗示这段车手与车队关系的逐渐恶化。哈斯早在夏休期后便通知奥孔大概率不会留队，而法拉利支持的青训车手拉法·卡马拉被认为是接替他的热门人选。
relatedItems.originalTitle: All the reasons the Ocon-Haas relationship fell apart
relatedItems.summaryEn: Esteban Ocon marked his exit from Haas with another reference to elements beyond his control, hinting at a gradual deterioration of the driver-team relationship. Haas decided long ago not to activate its contractual option and informed Ocon shortly after the summer break that he was unlikely to be retained.
keyPointsZh: 哈斯拥有下赛季保留奥孔的合同选择权，但早已决定不激活，并在夏休期后不久通知了他。
法拉利支持的拉法·卡马拉是最热门的接替人选，有人推测是法拉利对其青训车手的支持将奥孔挤出车门。
签约时奥孔是哈斯自2016年车队成立赛季引进罗曼·格罗斯让以来拥有的最成功车手。
keyPointsEn: Haas had a contractual option to retain Ocon for next year, decided long ago not to activate it, and notified him shortly after the summer break.
Ferrari-backed Rafa Camara is the favourite to replace Ocon, leading some to infer Ferrari's support of its junior driver is pushing Ocon out.
When signed, Ocon was the most successful driver Haas had employed since Romain Grosjean, a 10-time podium finisher who joined for the team's inaugural 2016 season.
